who: Leads a small platform team. Lets an agent read the logs before anyone else does. Back from parental leave last week, sleeping badly.

moments.plot: Logins were down for forty minutes on Tuesday, and the nursery wants an answer.

tasks.title: Agree the timeline with Maren
tasks.notes: The alert fired at 14:06. The first person saw it at 14:19. Talk about those thirteen minutes, kindly.

tasks.title: Alert 30 days before a certificate ends
tasks.notes: Page the team, not one person. One person was on leave. It was me.

tasks.title: Tell the two customers who wrote in
Add the other four to the calendar
Ask Maren about the conference talk

capture.title: Thank Tobias for the night shift

file.title: Who owns the status page?
file.notes: It said everything was fine for the whole forty minutes.

dated.title: Walk the team through the outage
dated.notes: Half an hour, no slides. Maren tells it, because she saw it first.

repeating.title: Hand over on-call
repeating.notes: What woke you up, and what should not have.

attachments.notes: Start with what you see, then what to do. Tobias found two steps that no longer exist. The graphs are from {weekday-3}.

tasks.title: Second test of the database copy

agent.title: Write the outage timeline from the logs
agent.notes: Alerts, chat and deploys from {weekday-3}, 14:00 to 15:00. Times only, no blame.
agent.question: Who will read it?
bodies: 14:02 certificate ends. 14:06 first alert. 14:19 Maren sees it. 14:31 new certificate requested. 14:42 logins work again.
Between 14:02 and 14:42 you could not sign in. A certificate had ended. We replaced it, and nobody’s data was affected.
agent.otherBody: Logins failed between 14:02 and 14:42 because a certificate had ended. Your direction: {answer}
agent.otherAnswer: Support, so they can answer customers
agent.acceptance: The timeline is ready to share.

discuss.title: Ask for a later stand-up
discuss.notes: Nursery drop-off is at 8:45. Stand-up is at nine, across town.
discuss.question: What would you like to ask for?
bodies: Hi all, could we move stand-up to half past nine? I do the nursery run now and arrive out of breath. Say so if it breaks your morning.
Hi all, could we do stand-up in writing on two days a week? I do the nursery run now, and I think we would all read faster than we talk.
discuss.otherBody: Hi all, I do the nursery run now and would like to change stand-up. {answer}
discuss.acceptance: The team knows what you are asking.

review.title: Write the outage timeline from the logs
review.note: Five entries. Two clocks disagree by a minute, so I used the alert log.

review.title: List every certificate we own
review.note: Nine found. One has no owner.
